column1: # card-funding-accounts.tsv — which deposit account each credit card's autopay actually draws from.
# A card-due reminder that names only the due date is not actionable: the failure on
# 2026-10-11 was not that a payment was due, it was that the payment was ARMED AGAINST AN
# ACCOUNT HOLDING 72.47. The issuer's own "automatic payment is scheduled" email says only
# "from your account" - it never names it. So the mapping has to be maintained here.
# Not by inference and never by guessing. A row goes in only when a bank-side debit and a
# card-side credit for THE SAME AMOUNT, opposite signs, and the same originator id have been
# matched. Both rows below were matched that way on 2026-10-14 against plaid_transactions.
# FORMAT  (pipe separated; # comments allowed; a label may contain spaces)
# A card with no row is REPORTED AS UNMAPPED, which is the honest answer. Do not fill the
# gap with a plausible account - a wrong funding account is worse than no reminder.

9650 | personal-checking | Chase checking ...9730 (the account named "CHASE COLLEGE") | 2026-10-14: bank debit +2380.06 on mask 9730 (2026-10-13, ORIG ID:4760039224) matches card credit -2380.06 on 9650 (2026-10-11, "AUTOMATIC PAYMENT - THANK")
